name: MedNLI
intro: MedNLI是一个临床三分类自然语言推理数据集，由临床医生基于MIMIC-III既往病史句子撰写蕴含、中立和矛盾假设。论文数据含14,049个句对并按前提互斥划分；当前PhysioNet发布需完成资质、培训并签署数据使用协议后访问。
org: University of Massachusetts Lowell, IBM Research
build_method: 临床病历规则抽取, 临床医生人工标注, 试点一致性审核
task_type: 自然语言推理, 分类
eval_feature: 临床三分类NLI, 前提互斥划分, 受限数据访问
build_method_en: Rule-based clinical-note extraction, clinician annotation, pilot agreement review
eval_feature_en: Three-way clinical NLI, premise-disjoint splits, credentialed data access
intro_en: MedNLI is a three-way clinical natural language inference dataset. Clinicians wrote entailment, neutral, and contradiction hypotheses from Past Medical History sentences derived from MIMIC-III. The paper dataset has 14,049 premise-hypothesis pairs in premise-disjoint splits; the current PhysioNet release requires credentialing, training, and a signed data-use agreement.

drawio_review_note: Paper/source alignment reviewed on 2026-07-21 against arXiv:1808.06752v2 (PDF SHA-256 d328fab8b04783b09a62e0535492dc26ecaa2cef14ba0930f80099476ba2a842), the official code repository at HEAD e1fe2531a9e97ca49203f4d3ef22c5cbf96f0d71, PhysioNet MedNLI v1.0.0 (DOI 10.13026/C2RS98), and BigBIO loader snapshot 21f3313de37d60d45fb67a276d63ace9c4a0ac7d. The workflow preserves the paper's MIMIC-III v1.3 source statistics, while explicitly separating the PhysioNet release page's MIMIC-III v1.4 parent claim. It covers deceased-patient notes; rule-based Past Medical History extraction; biomedical LingPipe splitting and random premise sampling; the exact premise-only clinician prompt; one definitely-true, might-be-true, and definitely-false hypothesis; the two-radiologist 100-premise-each pilot; clinician removal of 16 invalid premises; cross-labeling 552 pairs with Cohen's kappa 0.78; true-versus-maybe disagreement review; two additional clinicians; four clinicians annotating 4,683 premises over six weeks; and the explicit paper boundary that final pairs did not receive multiple annotations because of time and funding. The resulting 14,049 unique pairs are split without premise overlap into 11,232 train, 1,395 development, and 1,422 test pairs. PhysioNet access requires credentialing, CITI training, and a signed DUA under the PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; the code repository has no LICENSE file. The paper averages six random-seed runs and selects the lowest-validation-loss checkpoint. Pinned code reads label-bearing JSONL, drops rows whose gold_label is '-', takes argmax over three logits, and computes correct predictions divided by dataset length. Because PhysioNet documents the public test gold_label as redacted, those released test rows alone cannot reproduce the paper's held-out test accuracy. No hosted evaluator, generic output parser, composite score, or official live leaderboard is claimed. Formal publication evidence [site-a11t-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3298×1025 (English) and 3298×1025 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3296×1023 and 3296×1023. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
